batting.dismissal: c KS Williamson b KV Sharma

batting.name: AB de Villiers
batting.dismissal: c S Dhawan b TA Boult

batting.name: Mandeep Singh
batting.dismissal: c DA Warner b RS Bopara

batting.name: SA Abbott
batting.dismissal: c KV Sharma b TA Boult

batting.dismissal: c KS Williamson b TA Boult

batting.name: KS Williamson
batting.dismissal: st KD Karthik b YS Chahal

balls.text: another yorker, another wicket. Right in the blockhole on middle. Nechim can't dig it out. RCB bowled out for 166; the last five wickets falling for 14 runs
full and wide outside off, thrashed to point. They scramble across for a single
Bhuvi nails the yorker, the middle stump is pegged back. Right in the blockhole, Aaron, having backed away, can't squeeze it out. Aaron misses, Bhuvi hits now
he misses the yorker, half-volley slower ball outside off, Aaron picks it up and launches it over long-off
full and wide outside off, Aaron wants to lash a drive but misses
back of a length and outside off, Abu Nechim backs away and carves it away to the deep third man fence

What.an.over from Boult. Banged in short and rises awkwardly on Harshal, who goes for the pull. He can only splice it in the air. Williamson rushes in and completes a smart catch at midwicket. He tumbles onto the ground after taking it
banged in short and climbs on the leg stump, Harshal jerks his head out of the way. Wide called for height
back of a length and outside off, slashed away to deep third man

two in two for Boult, foils RCB's attempt of a late surge. Short and wide outside off, Abbott steps away, winds up for a big blow and skews it to the air. The man at covers moves to his left and collects it
Caught at sweeper cover. Crucial wicket for SRH. This was on a length and outside off, AB slices it high into the air. Dhawan settles under it at sweeper cover. More off the toe-end of the bat, that

Full marks for placement!  AB jumps across off, he takes the full toss from there and swats it away to the cow corner boundary. KL Rahul (from long-on) and Kane Williamson (deep midwicket) converge and nearly collide in the deep. AB bisects the gap, surgical precision
full and wide outside off, Abbott slashes it away and dispatches it to the sweeper boundary. The man in the deep can't cut that off. PK is not pleased with the effort in the deep
swing and misses to an off-speed ball outside off
very full and on middle and leg, drilled down to long-on
low full toss, he steps out, shuffles across off and launches it over the long leg boundary
darted full on the leg stump, not quite a yorker. He can't whip it away and takes it on the pad and crosses over for a scampered leg bye
yorker on the leg stump, Abbott manages an inside edge and squeezes it fine on the leg side
low full toss just outside off, duly put away. AB craves it away to the sweeper cover boundary. Poor way to end the over. AB is the key here for RCB
AB looks to back away, Bhuvi sprays it wide outside off. The former can't reach out and slices it away. Past the tram-line
on a length and on middle and leg, hacked away towards deep midwicket off the inside half of the bat
yorker at the base of off, AB wound up for a big blow, but can only jab it over the bowler
low full toss on middle, squeezed away towards deep midwicket
back of a length and outside off, he wants to slug it across the line but misses
back of a length and on the hips, AB aims to whip it away but takes it on the pad. They take off for a single, the bowler rushes in to collect the ball but does not hit the stumps

Ashish Reddy's yorker consumes Sammy. Right in the blockhole at the base of off, Sammy wants to swing it away from Bangalore to Mysore. But only meets with a whole lot of thin air. The off-stump is rattled. RCB pegged back further
back of a length and on middle and leg, dragged away to long-on
back of a length and on the leg stump, AB can't lay bat onto it
AB shuffles across off, takes it from there and slog-sweeps it up and over deep backward square leg. Wonderful strike
on a length and on middle and leg, mis-timed sweep to deep backward square. Deep square runs to his right to cut that off
on a length and on off, whipped away towards wide long-on
darted flat on the leg stump, no room at all. Off the pad and runs away to short fine
leg stumpish, AB inside-edges the slog sweep and finds short fine, straight to the fielder
Sammy gets a leading edge and chips it in front of mid-on
skids off the deck on off, Sammy looks to cut but can only squirt it back to the bowler
slid through on middle and leg, driven to long-on
pushed down to long-off

Dhawan takes the catch but the momentum takes him over the long-on boundary. This was banged in short and outside off, AB has to fetch the pull from there. Sort of mis-times the swatted-pull high into the sky. Dhawan leaps, catches it but lacks awareness. Instead of flicking it back and trying to take it on the rebound, he goes over the ropes
pitched up and outside off, drilled to sweeper cover
AB is down the track, Bopara drags his length back a touch. Pushed down the ground for a single
on a length and on off, AB jumps across and unfurls an uppish lap sweep, wide of short fine leg
slower offering outside off, AB wants to lash it through the covers. He is early into the shot and manages an outside edge to Boult at short third
back of a length and on off, Sammy hangs back and turns it to the right of midwicket to avert the hattrick
fuller and around off, tapped through the covers for one
looped up on middle, driven down to long-off
flighted and full on middle, jammed back to the bowler
darted short on off, Sammy rocks back and pulls it away to long-on
veering onto the pads, nudged to short fine
googly, pushed down to long-on

Warner pulls off stunner! One-handed.. Thanks for coming, Mandy. This was fuller and on middle, looks like a legcutter that grips in the pitch. Mandy wants to clip it away to the leg and loops it into the air off a leading edge. Warner flies to his right from short cover, both feet off the ground, and plucks it out one-handed. Whoa.

two wickets in two overs for SRH. This was on a back of a length, Kohli backs away, has some leverage to thrash through the off side, but makes no contact. Bopara hits the top of the off-stump, Kohli gone for 41
mighty full and outside off, shovel-driven to long-off
fuller and on middle and leg, clipped to mid-on
on a length and outside off, AB pushes at it and gets an outside edge through the vacant slip cordon. Three fours in a row
slower, short ball outside off. Lashed away past the covers. Sweeper can't cut that off. Superb connection from AB
looks like Kohli has cranked up to top gear. Tossed up and outside off, he runs down the track and lofts it over the covers. Long-off can't cut that off either, scooted away to the boundary
slid through on middle and leg, AB does not have enough room to work with. Steered in front of sweeper cover
back of a length and on the hips, punched away to the leg side
flat and darted in on off, squeezed past the diving cover fielder. Kohli waits for the ball to pass the fielder and then responds to the single
full and outside off, pushed into the covers

Karn Sharma strikes to get rid of DK for 9. Pushed through flat and quick on middle, DK hunts for a slog-sweep after going down on one knee. Gets a top-edge and shoots it up in the air. Kane Williamson comes forward from point and pouches it
PK rolls his fingers across this slower ball, Kohli is foxed. He is early into the push and is beaten
on a length and on middle and leg, nudged to short fine for an urgent single
similar length and around off, dabbed in front of point
back of a length and outside off, steered away to deep third man
this one is even better. Very, very, wristy. Very full, change of pace and outside off, he goes deep in the crease and swats it over the wide long-on boundary. Picked it up and executed it well
top strike from Kohli. The bowler drags his length back on off, Kohli nips down the track, adjusts and lifts it over the covers
Karn drags his length back, Kohli takes a step forward and swats it away towards deep midwicket. Settles for one now
Karn slides this through on middle and leg, tucked away through midwicket. Kohli wants a couple and scampers across
fuller and on middle and leg, driven down to long-on
punched down to long-on

and Karn spills a return catch. This was pushed through on middle and leg, Kohli backs away, takes a step forward and drills it back to the bowler. Karn messes it up the reverse-cup catch on the first attempt. Tries to take it off the rebound but drops it again
dug in short on off, DK switches his balance to the back foot and pulls it away to long-on, where Boult slides and makes a good stop
PK drags his length back on seeing Kohli come down the track, pushed into the covers
on a length and on off, Kohli's bat twists on impact as he tucks it away to the leg side
fuller and on the leg stump, Kohli does not meet with the glance. Off the pad and rolls away to the left of the keeper
good length ball on off, which is pushed back to the bowler

superb running between the wickets again! Back of a length and on off, dabbed behind point. Kohli wants a quick single again, dives and makes his crease, even as Williamson swoops in on the ball. He failed to throw the stumps down, though
back of a length and outside off, Kohli closes his bat face and gets an inside-edge that wanders away towards midwicket
on a fuller length and on middle and leg, Kohli brings his wrists into play and picks it away through the vacant midwicket region
on the pads again, deflected to the right of short fine leg off the pad
straighter in line, Kohli hangs back and tucks it away towards the man at 45 again
low full toss, driven neatly. But Warner flings to his left at mid-off and cuts that off
back of a length and on middle, DK dinks it away to Bhuvi at short fine. Kohli calls for a single and races across to the other end
fuller and straighter, turned wide of mid-on
very full and slid down leg, Kohli misses the flick, the keeper is beaten as well. Bonus runs for RCB
veering onto the pads, DK takes a step forward and glances it away fine on the leg side for a four
Praveen Kumar targets off, DK defends it
on a back of a length and DK blocks it calmly

That's a big, big wicket, Gayle swings again and finds the man at deep backward square. This was on the pads, Gayle picks it up and hits it right into the palms of Ashish Reddy. Simple catch, he did not even have to budge. So, the two men, who came into the XI, effect the first breakthrough
Length ball from Praveen, Gayle has an almighty swing at it and drags it off an inside-edge, beats mid-on
back of a length and on the leg stump, Gayle is early into the flick and does not get hold of the stroke. Might have been a slower one there from PK
Boult drags his length back on off, Kohli manages to get on top of the bounce and tap it in front of point. He hunts for a single, but is sent back. Gayle doesn't like quick singles
pitched up and angling away outside off, Kohli pushes at it and watches the ball beat the outside edge again
back of a length and moving away with the angle outside off, the fishing rod is out and Kohli is beaten
Kohli comes down the track, takes it on the full and whips it away to the right of midwicket. The fielder's dive amounts to nothing
pitched up and angled far too wide outside off, Kohli reaches out, but can't connect with it. Wide called by the umpire
back of a length, accompanied by some inward movement on off, pushed back to the bowler off an inside-edge
imperious strike from Kohli. Length delivery on off, Kohli gets underneath and whacks it over long-on. Chants of ARR-CEE-BEE ring around the Chinnaswamy. Cleared the fence with ease
back of a length and sliding across Gayle. He can't resist his temptation as he pokes and misses
similar length and slanted across Gayle, who lets it pass
back of a length and creeps away outside off, Gayle stands tall and forces it past the covers. Just exploded to the boundary from the meat of the bat
pitched up and sliding across Gayle, who shoulders arms
skiddy ball on middle and leg, Gayle hangs back and blocks it in front of mid-on
back of a length and outside off, Kohli meets it with an open face and steers it away to deep third man
back of a length, Kohli gets an inside-edge, that wanders away to the leg side
Boult swings it down leg, wided

inswinger from Boult, Kohli aims for a drive but does not cover for the movement. He is beaten and is struck on the pad in front of off. That looked seriously close, the ball lobs off the pad to Dhawan at first slip. No inside-edge on that, but wasn't that plumb lbw?
back of a length and climbs over the off stump as Kohli swipes across the line and misses
on a good length and outside off, Kohli comes forward and punches it to the covers. Bopara fumbles there, no harm done for SRH
Boult does not control the swing now, drifts it down leg
pitched up on off, Boult gets this to curve in as well. Kohli aims for a flashy drive and manages an inside-edge onto the pad
fuller and moving across Gayle, who hangs his bat out, zips past the outside edge. Good riposte from Bhuvi
Bhuvi darts a yorker and gets it to wobble in on the leg stump as Gayle advances. Yet, the Jamaican whips his wrists and forces it to the left of mid-on. It just sped away to the boundary
wide line outside off, Kohli uses the pace of the bowler and guides it away to deep third man
on a length and swings away outside off, Kohli reaches out and slices it in front of point
crackalicious. This was by no means a half-volley, swings away a touch as well. Kohi gets forward, punchily drives it on the up and sends it whistling past the covers
back of a length and around off, Kohli defends it carefully
near yorker swings back in on the leg stump, Gayle jabs his bat down and squeezes it to short fine
on a back of a length and curling away outside off, Gayle opts for caution and leaves it alone
a tad fuller and outside off, Gayle attacks it and slices it over the covers for a couple of runs. He was not in control of that one
on a length and just outside off, Gayle flexes his muscles and slugs it into the sightscreen. Soars over long-on
beaten emphatically is Gayle. Angled in and swings away past the nervy waft of Gayle
Boult swings this one down leg, Kohli is beaten on the glance, the keeper is half beaten as RCB sneak in a run to add to the wide
pitched up and swings away close to off, Gayle hangs back and pokes it off an outside edge, runs away to third man. Some movement in the air straightaway
Rahul wraps up a clinical SRH win with a six. Juicy full toss on middle and leg, picked away over backward square leg. Wristy stuff from Rahul
length on leg, Rahul, having backed away, has enough leverage to slap it straight down the ground, beats mid-off comfortably
Abu Nechim hurls in a yorker at the base of off, Dhawan angles his bat and digs it out
very full and on off, Dhawan picks it up from there after shuffling across and launches it over deep midwicket. Collects his fifty
very short and hurries on off, Rahul looks for a pull but reins in his impulse. Loops over mid-off off leading edge. That's a big no-ball
banged in short and on the leg stump, Dhawan lifts one feet in the air and controls a pull in front of deep backward square

back of a length and on middle, tucks Rahul up for room, turned to midwicket. AB tries to intercept the ball with his right boot, does so but lands on the outside of his foot after stopping the ball. Oops, he may have twisted his foot
drifting down leg, DK dives across to his left, but can't stop the ball. Sneaks away to the fine-leg boundary. Kohli is frustrated. That's five wides
the pair look for two and pick it. On a fuller length and on off, Rahul comes forward and lasers a drive to long-off
yorker at the base of off, dug out in front of the covers for a speedy single
overpitched and outside off, Rahul flays it to the covers. Kohli half-stops it and wrings his hands in pain
pushed through on middle, sort of stops on Rahul, who checks his attempted drive and chips it in front of long-on
pushed through on middle, Dhawan advances down the track and slugs it away to long-on
slid through quick and on off, he can only jerk it away to the covers. They take on AB again and pinch a single. AB has a shy at the striker's end but can't throw the stumps down
leggie on middle from Yuzi, Dhawan reverse-sweeps it in front of short third. He did not get hold of the stroke
Yuzi gives this more air, chipped over mid-off
tossed up, Rahul is down the track, does not get close to the pitch of the ball. Drags it to the left of Kohli at midwicket off the inside half of the bat
back of a length, this one skids on off. Dhawan does not have enough room to free his arms and chops it in front of point
dug in short and outside off, not enough pace to trouble Dhawan. He rocks back and pummels it over the square leg boundary with a pull
back of a length and punched tamely to the covers
similar ball, he can't put this way. Off the pad and to the left of the keeper
shortish and leg-stumpish, Rahul swivels on the back foot and eases it to the long leg boundary
back of a length and on middle, Rahul aims for a pull, mishits it in the air to the left of AB (I guess) at midwicket. Sammy has it covered at long-on
back of a length and around off, tapped to the man with the orange cap at point - Chris Gayle
fraction back of a length and on off, whippily driven down to long-on
back of a length and outside off, Dhawan swings and gets a thick outside edge that flies to deep third
this one skids on outside off, messes with Dhawan's attempted drive. Off the inside half of the bat, back to the bowler
full and outside off, Rahul gets forward and drives it to the left of mid-off
another leg-side wide. Abbott has lost the plot
yorker down leg, wide called
fuller and straighter, he shuffles across and turns it to midwicket
Aaron overcorrects, very short on middle and leg, he nurdles a single behind square on the leg side
low full toss on the hips, picked away with the wrists to deep mdiwicket
short and ruses on top of off and middle, Dhawan hangs back and defends it to the off side
shortish and outside off, Rahul hops up, looks to punch it away. The inside-edge misses the leg stump, again
bumper from Aaron, Rahul shelves the hook and drops his hands on it. Wide signalled for height
back of a length and outside off, Dhawan chases it with a drive. Slices it down to deep third man off an outside edge
dug in shortish and on the hips, clipped away towards long leg
Yuzi tosses this up, Rahul comes down the track, does not meet the pitch of the ball. Just about manages to chip it over Yuzi. He stretched his hands, but it did not stick
dug in shortish and on top of middle, Dhawan sits back and forces it down to long-on
pushed through, driven down to long-on for an easy single
Yuzi gives this more air, dabbed into the covers
beautiful. Tossed up on middle, Rahul comes down the track and lofts it over the bowler's head. Who said T20s are just for freelance clubbers of the ball?
Dhawan chips down the track and nearly yorks himself. Pushed down to long-off
dug in shortish and outside off, Rahul rocks back and strongly pulls it over midwicket
pitched up and outside off, sliced in front of square on the off side
pitched up and on off, he comes forward, drives it to mid-on. They take on AB's arm and scamper across for a single
short and on middle stumps, punched down the ground past Sammy. Long-on moves to his left and hunts the ball down, keeping it to a single
Misses the leg stump by a whisker. Back of a length and comes in close to off, Rahul aims to dab it away. Has to settle with an inside-edge that dribbles past the leg stump
back of a length and straighter in line, tucked away in front of square on the leg side off the back foot
flighted on off, knocked to mid-off as he gets off the mark straightaway

Yuzi and DK pose a question. Is Williamson out stumped? He is in trouble and Williamson has to go. Sharp work from the keeper. The umpires check for a possible no-ball, its a legal ball. Williamson started walking even before OUT flashed on the big screen. Williamson dragged himself forward and does not meet with the sweep. This quicker ball beats him, sneaks through and DK whips the bails off in super quick time to catch Williamson short. His backfoot was not grounded when it mattered
fuller and on middle and off, helped down to long-off
short legbreak outside off, forced to the off-side sweeper
flat on middle and leg, pushed down the ground. Yuzi dives and deflects it to the right of mid-on. Sammy has it covered
tossed up, driven down to long-off
he strays on the pads again, clipped in front of square on the leg side
dug in shortish and on off, Dhawan rocks back and pulls it to deep midwicket with one feet lifted in the air
whipped away off the hips, directed to deep backward square
banged in short and seams in on off, Williamson punches it down to long-off
Harshal Patel's radar goes haywire as he errs down leg, Williamson helps it away fine on the leg side
back of a length and outside off, punched to the covers
googly from Chahal. Shortish and skids around off, Williamson checks his punch and plays it behind point
The opening stand has been broken, courtesy Yuzi. Kohli is pumped. This was flighted on middle, Warner goes low for a sweep but misses and is struck on the back pad. The umpire raises his forefinger
looped up on middle, Yuzi drags his length back as well. Dhawan comes down the track, adjusts and taps it down to long-off
short again, pulled away to deep backward square, straight to the fielder
what.a.shot! Dug in shortish and on middle and leg, Warner rocks back and slugs it over deep backward square
pushed through on middle and leg, whipped away towards wide long-on
back of a length and hurries onto the hips, jabbed down to long-on
this was on a length and outside off, Dhawan offers a high elbow and punches it to the right of long-off for a boundary
dragged shortish and outside off, punched down to long-off for a punchy fifty. He has put SRH on course
pitched up on middle and leg, curves in a touch. Driven in front of long-on for one
dug in on a back of a length and outside off, punched to point
sprayed wide outside off, Warner reaches out and crashes it to deep point
back of a length and outside off, there was a resounding crack as Dhawan met the ball. Punched to point, straight to the fielder
back of a length and on the hips, half paddled and half pulled towards deep backward square
back of a length and skids on middle, foils the cut. Chopped to cover-point
short and wide outside off, soft and sits up to be hit. Warner does not need a second invitation for a pull. He sits back and sends it soaring over long-on
fuller length and on off, Warner wants to whack it away to the leg side. Drags it back to the bowler off the base of the bat
fuller and on middle and leg, whipped away to mid-on
on a good length and hurled across Dhawan, who pushes at it with no feet movement and is beaten on the outside edge
slippery short ball, Warner happily swats it away towards deep square leg
yorker at the base of off, jammed into the covers
amazing strike from Warner. Banged in short on the middle stumps, Warner makes room and cracks an upper cut - flat and over third man
dug in short and put away! Warner takes it from there, the man at midwicket dived to his left and took some pace off the ball, yet it travelled to the boundary
Lusty blow from Warner. On a length and on middle, Warner clears his front leg and sends it thudding into the sightscreen
on a length and outside off, Dhawan crunches it straight to AB at cover-point
shortish and on middle, punchily blocked back to the bowler
very full and on the pads, picked away down the ground
back of a length and on off, not all that short enough. Seams in off the deck, mis-hit pull towards midwicket
fuller and straighter, clipped away in front of square on the leg side
short of a length and outside off, Dhawan stays back and chops it to point
back of a length and on middle, Warner hangs back and bunts it to the covers. The fielder lets it through, but mid-off hunts that down
very full and on off, pushed to the covers
another full toss outside off, Dhawan slices it, AB dives to his right from cover-point and intercepts it. He got hit on the wrist while diving. That must sting
yorker, right in the blockhole, swings in the leg stump, Dhawan nearly falls over but digs it out in front of mid-on
poor ball, full toss outside off. Driven away past AB, who was diving to his right at cover-point. Skedaddles away to the boundary
shortish and rises on middle, Dhawan hangs back and defends it back to the bowler
Whack!! that's the sound of a good start. Short of length, this is swatted into the stand behind midwicket. Cheryl's loving this
poor delivery! Looks for the yorker but serves up a high full toss on off stump, all Warner has to do is to punch it in the gap. AB can just watch it skim past him at covers
back of length on off and coming in with the angle, the batsman whips it to the leg side but finds Kohli at midwicket
pushes this one fuller but this is well wide outside off
corrects his line but serves up a medium-paced dolly outside off. Warner stands tall and slaps it back at the bowler at extreme speeds. He didn't have a chance to stop that one
another one on the pads and Warner just whips it off his hips, picks it up above the short fine leg fielder. Easily finds the boundary Poor lines from Patel
length delivery but this on the pads, easily tucked away past midwicket for a single
pulls the length back. Dhawan stays in the crease and nudges it to deep square leg with the angle
more runs! This is full and angled in towards the middle stumps, Dhawan just whips it through midwicket, all along the ground. There was a sweeper in the deep but he had no chance
that's a Dhawan special! He takes a small step forward and punches the fuller delivery through extra cover. No flourish of the bat, just a neat looking push.. blazes away
he is pushing it fuller in search of the swing but that is allowing the batsman to drive it, Warner pushes it past the non-striker for a single to mid-off
nice swing into the left-hander here but Warner manages to tuck it past midwicket for a couple
gets a juicy full toss first up that is driven away through covers. Abbott's idea was right.. he was looking for the yorker, but pushed it too far up
